name: Raven-Code
description: A powerful coding agent that can write, run and debug code on this host, then report what it did. Use it for a fix, a small feature, a script, or a failing test. IMPORTANT: it edits your files for real, and nothing locks the checkout: when several Raven-Code tasks run at the same time against one working directory, give each task its own set of files and say so in its prompt; a session is told when others are working beside it.
owns: owns coding: writing, running or debugging code. Do not write the code yourself.
